brief:
The Trump administration has concluded, according to Middle East Eye, marking a potential turning point in regional geopolitics. Commentary suggests the transition has prompted concern among Israeli and Gulf Arab leadership about the direction of U.S. policy in the Middle East.

The departure signals uncertainty over Washington's future stance toward Iran, Israel, and Gulf monarchies that relied heavily on Trump-era alignment. Regional observers view the leadership change as a moment for reassessment of long-standing strategic partnerships and security arrangements in the eastern Mediterranean and Persian Gulf.

title: Trump era ends amid shifts in Middle East alignment
